Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the chase! The players are walking out to the middle. Aaron Finch and David Warner are the two openers for Australia. The former is not in good form and will be looking to get things right in this match. Trent Boult has been given the responsibility to start with the first new ball. Here we go...
... THE RUN CHASE ...

Right then, a target of 233 on this pitch could prove to be tricky if Australia don't get a good start. Under lights, the likes of Trent Boult, Matt Henry and Lockie Ferguson can make the ball talk, so it's not going to be a straightforward chase for the hosts. Let's wait and watch what's in store. Do join us in a short while.

Glenn Maxwell (10-0-52-4) says that it's a nice day out there. Feels that New Zealand batted well at the start but the Australian bowlers did well to restrict them. Maxwell opines that it might skid on under the lights. On his catch to dismiss Guptill, Maxwell replies that it's all about reflexes and it was nice for that catch to stick.

Australia did a brilliant job to keep a lid on the scoring rate. All their bowlers were impressive and bowled disciplined lines. Aaron Finch's bowling changes and field placement were also excellent. Apart from Cameron Green and Marcus Stoinis, all the bowlers took at least one wicket. The pick has to be Glenn Maxwell who hunted down four wickets and also achieved his best bowling figures in ODIs. Here he is, having a quick chat...

It's not a traditional Australian pitch, and the approach adopted by New Zealand was also old school. They spent time being careful, and their innings lacked intent. Perhaps, the idea was to take it deep, have wickets in hand and then launch an attack in the end overs. They had the platform set, but the fast train never arrived. Six wickets fell in the last ten overs, never a good thing if you want to go big.
New Zealand have huffed and puffed to reach 232 here. A very unconvincing batting show from them. Regardless of the conditions, Aaron Finch will be pleased with his decision to bowl first.

Only a single to end the innings! This is full again and on off, Lockie Ferguson drives it straight to covers and sets off for a run. Smith picks it up and has a shy at the bowler's end but misses and Ferguson makes his ground. New Zealand end on 232 for 9.
Mitchell Starc follows Boult and serves a full delivery, on leg, Trent Boult swings hard and gets an inside edge towards fine leg for a single. Boult is looking for the second run but is sent back.
FOUR! Edgy but effective. 230 up for the Black Caps. Starc attempts for a yorker but ends up delivering a full toss, Trent Boult throws his bat at it and edges it down to third man for a boundary.
Goes full and on off, Lockie Ferguson drives it through extra cover for a run.
This is on a hard length and on off, Trent Boult makes room, clears his front leg and smashes it towards wide long off for just a run.
Full and outside off, Lockie Ferguson drills it down to long on for a run.
Trent Boult is the last man in.

OUT! Strangled down the leg side! Clever deception from Josh Hazlewood and that earns him his third wicket. The line is not great as it's down the leg side but the pace is only 117.2 kph. Mitchell Santner tries to tickle it fine when he should have looked to whip it across the line and the ball takes a faint inside edge of his bat. Alex Carey has the simplest of catches to grab and the number 9 goes down for the Kiwis.
Commentary.Howout: c Alex Carey b Josh Hazlewood

Commentary.Commentary: A slower length ball, on off, Lockie Ferguson slashes at it but mistimes it in the air, the ball lands well short of long off. A single taken.
Short and on middle, Mitchell Santner pulls it but straight to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Nails the yorker, on middle, Lockie Ferguson digs it out towards mid-wicket for a single.
Lockie Ferguson is in.

OUT! Excellent catch from Mitchell Starc and Santner turning the strike over was indeed not a great decision!​ Josh Hazlewood angles in a length ball around off, Matt Henry's attempt to heave it over the leg side flops as the ball takes the inside half of his blade and loops to the right side of mid-wicket. Mitchell Starc completes a nice tumbling catch and New Zealand lose their eighth wicket.
Commentary.Howout: c Mitchell Starc b Josh Hazlewood

Commentary.Commentary: On a length and on middle, Mitchell Santner stays back and works it towards mid-wicket for a run. Not sure if he should have taken the single.
Just over! This is full and on middle, Matt Henry stays there and lofts it towards mid on where David Warner runs back and perhaps gets his right hand to it, but cannot grab it. Two runs are taken.
Fuller in length and on middle, Mitchell Santner chips it down to long on for a run.
FOUR! This will help New Zealand. Full and outside off, it's chipped over extra cover for a boundary.
Full and outside off, Matt Henry drives it towards long off and rotates the strike.
A yorker on off, Matt Henry moves across to work it to the leg side but gets an outside edge towards cover. He needs to give the strike to Santner.
This is full and on middle, angling in, Matt Henry defends it down the pitch.
Full and outside off, Matt Henry drills it through covers and takes a single.
On a length and on off, Matt Henry knocks it towards short cover.
Matt Henry walks out.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! It's a big blow to New Zealand's chances of getting to 250. Josh Hazlewood maintains his line around off and delivers it on a shortish length at 134.8 kph, James Neesham attempts to be inventive as he walks across the stumps to scoop it over short fine leg. All he manages is to play it from the face of his bat to Alex Carey who takes a simple catch behind the stumps.
Commentary.Howout: c Alex Carey b Josh Hazlewood

Commentary.Commentary: Swing and a miss! This is the knuckle ball from Hazlewood, on a length and outside off, James Neesham has a wild swing at it but cannot connect as he is through his shot quite early.
Back of a length and on leg, Mitchell Santner flicks it through square leg for one more.
Short and on middle, James Neesham pulls it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Floated and on middle, Mitchell Santner pushes it back to the bowler. Glenn Maxwell finishes with 4 wickets for 52 runs in his 10 overs.
Shorter in length and on off, James Neesham forces it through covers for one.

SIX! It's time to unleash the Neesh! Maxwell darts in a full ball around off, skidding in, James Neesham hurries down the track and uses the angle of the bowler to hammer it over deep backward square leg for a maximum.
Tossed up, full and on middle, James Neesham looks to slog it but mistimes it towards mid-wicket.
Angles a short delivery, on leg, Mitchell Santner tucks it through mid-wicket for a run.
Short and around off, Mitchell Santner goes on his back foot and punches it towards covers where the fielder lets it through. Two runs are taken. 200 up!
Full and on middle, James Neesham heaves it wide of the deep mid-wicket fielder for a couple of runs.
WIDE! Full and down the leg side, James Neesham misses his flick, Alex Carey appeals for the caught behind to save the wide. The umpire is having none of it and calls a wide.
Another run as this length ball is guided towards point.
Length this time but on the pads, James Neesham helps it towards fine leg for another run.
Short of a length again, and outside off, Mitchell Santner pushes it towards backward point for a run.
Short and on middle and leg, James Neesham pulls it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
This is on a good length and on leg, James Neesham looks to work it to the leg side but gets a leading edge to the left of the bowler, but it is too far away from Hazlewood.
Adam Zampa is done with the ball for the day. Josh Hazlewood (7-1-17-0) will replace him.
Goes shorter and on leg, Mitchell Santner stays back and defends it to the leg side.
Tossed up, full and on leg, Mitchell Santner knocks it down the pitch.
Mitchell Santner walks in next.

OUT! TAKEN! Another catch for Smith and he has helped Maxwell in getting his fourth wicket of the match. This is smart bowling from Maxy, he perhaps senses the charge and drags the length short along with pushing it wide outside off. Michael Bracewell advances down the track but has to reach out for his shot. As a result, he couldn't get the timing and Steven Smith stretches a bit to his right at covers to complete the catch. New Zealand's inning is going downhill at the backend.
Commentary.Howout: c Steven Smith b Glenn Maxwell

Commentary.Commentary: Stumping appeal has been referred upstairs. Quicker and flatter outside off, short in length, Bracewell tries to cut but misses and Alex Carey takes the bails off. He appeals and the square leg umpire refers it. The side-on angle finds Bracewell safely in and then the Snicko and Hot Spot find no evidence of an outside edge.
Quicker, short and around off, Michael Bracewell bunts it towards backward point.
Short and on off, James Neesham cuts it to deep point for a single.
Flighted and on middle, James Neesham lofts it towards long on, gets it more from the bottom half and it did not carry to the fielder. A single taken.
Short and on middle, Michael Bracewell goes back and works it through mid-wicket for a single.
A googly, on middle, turning away, Michael Bracewell guides it towards point.
Floated and around off, James Neesham again tries for the reverse sweep but the ball loops up off his gloves towards the short third man area, for a run.
Quicker one, on middle, James Neesham knocks it back to the bowler.
Tossed up, full and on middle and leg, James Neesham goes for the reverse sweep but hits it straight to point.
Flatter and full, on leg, James Neesham flicks it towards mid-wicket for a single and gets off the mark.
James Neesham is the next batter. Two new batters in the middle for New Zealand, the good thing is that they both are known for playing the big shots.

OUT! CAUGHT! Glenn Maxwell continues to have a good day in the field. A stupendous catch to start with and now he has his third wicket. Fires this one flat, it's a bit short and skidding into the batters from middle and leg, Latham goes down to sweep but it takes the upper half of his bat and flies to short fine leg. A simple catch for Adam Zampa and a batter who has faced 50-plus balls departs at a crunch moment for New Zealand.
Commentary.Howout: c Adam Zampa b Glenn Maxwell

Commentary.Commentary: Darted down the leg side, Michael Bracewell misses his flick and the ball deflects off his pads towards short fine leg. A leg bye taken.
FOUR! Michael Bracewell showing good intent and also displaying his recent good form. Given the charge to a full ball and drills it back past his partner at the other end for a boundary at long on.

Bracewell starts off with a nice shot! This is tossed up, full and on leg, Michael Bracewell skips down the track and lofts it with a straight bat and wide of long on where Marcus Stoinis covers the ground to his left, dives and stops it from crossing the fence. Two runs.
Michael Bracewell comes in.

OUT! CAUGHT! Mitchell sees the opportunity to dominate a part-timer but perishes. Maxwell keeps it simple, delivers it full and around middle, Daryl Mitchell advances down the track to flick but it takes the inner portion of his bat and flies straight into the hands of Steven Smith at short mid-wicket. A simple catch for Smudge and Australia continue to grab timely wickets. The pitch is clearly holding up and that produced a faulty stroke.
Commentary.Howout: c Steven Smith b Glenn Maxwell

Commentary.Commentary: Change. Glenn Maxwell is back on for his final spell.
A googly now, on middle, turning in, Daryl Mitchell goes back and clips it through mid-wicket for a run.
Short and on middle, Tom Latham pulls it towards deep square leg for a single.
Tossed up, full and on middle, Tom Latham uses his feet but only manages to block it. He is not happy with himself.
Floated and around off, Tom Latham blocks it out.
FOUR! This is now Latham's best ODI score against Australia. Fuller and around off, Tom Latham brings out the reverse-batted shot and nails it behind backward point for a boundary.
Flighted on middle, turning in as it's a googly, Daryl Mitchell pushes it past the right of the bowler for a single.
Powerplay 3! Now, a maximum of five fielders are allowed outside the circle till the last over.
On middle, it's pushed to mid on. A dot to end the over. 7 runs off it. New Zealand need a few double-digit overs.
Short in length and outside off. Latham tries to hit over mid on but mistimes and will get only a couple as the fielder runs back and cuts it off.
Very full and on middle. Mitchell drills it to mid on for one.
On a length and outside off. Mitchell steers it to backward point.
Length and on middle. Defended off the front foot.
FOUR! A much needed boundary! Mitchell breaks the shackles! Short of a length and around off. Mitchell knocks it over mid on for a boundary.

On the pads, quicker and it is flicked to short fine leg. Another good over from Zampa. It is high time for New Zealand to press on the gas now. They have wickets in hand and either of these two needs to play the aggressive role.
Too short this time, outside off. Mitchell pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Tossed up, outside off. Mitchell steps down and across to sweep but misses and gets hit on the pads. The impact was way outside off.
Mitchell sees the length is a touch short and pulls it past mid-wicket for a couple of runs.
Very full, floated and outside off. Mitchell jams it out back to Zampa.
Tossed up, around off. Latham eases it to long off and rotates the strike.
Length and around off. Blocked to mid on.
On a length and outside off. Latham guides it to deep backward point for a single.
Full ball, around off. Mitchell hits it through the line and to mid off and scampers across for a quick single. There is a shy at the bower's end but Mitchell was well in.
A bit slower this time, length and outside off. Mitchell drops it to point.
Outside off, it's punched to sweeper cover for a single.
Length ball, nipping back in around middle. Mitchell flicks it through mid-wicket for a single.
Marcus Stoinis ( 4-0-14-0) has been brought back into the attack.
Flighted ball, full and on middle. Latham leans and defends it out.
Quicker again on middle. Mitchell forces it to long on for a run.
Flatter ball on middle. Latham turns it to deep square leg for a single.
Touch short, quicker and outside off. Latham punches it to covers.
On middle, kept out.
FOUR! Welcome boundary for the Kiwis! A loopy ball, full and outside off. Latham comes down the track and lofts it over Zampa's head, straight for four.
Slight hold-up in play. The zing bails are not lighting up and the umpire tries his best to get it corrected. For now, they are continuing with the same bails.

Adam Zampa is back on. Slight hold-up in play. The zing bails are not lighting up at the striker's end and the umpire tries his best to get it corrected. For now, they are continuing with the same bails.

Flatter ball and around off. Mitchell punches off the back foot, wide of deep point for a couple of runs. The boundaries are hard to buy and New Zealand are doing well to find the gap and bag some braces.
This time Mitchell reverse-sweeps it through point and comes back for the second run.
Around off, flicked to mid-wicket.
Was there an edge? It was off the arms! Tossed up, around leg. Mitchell looks to reverse sweep but misses and gets hit on his front arm. The ball lobs well in front of the keeper.
Outside off, dabbed to deep backward point for a single.
Serves it short and outside off. Laham defends on the back foot.
Length ball, outside off. Mitchell defends it on the deck.
On the pads, it's tickled to fine leg for a single.
On a length and outside off at 132 kph. Latham looks to cut but misses.
Outside off on a length. Mitchell taps it in front of point for a quick single.
Slower one, full and on middle. Mitchell keeps it out on the leg side.
Shorter and on middle. Latham pulls it flat and hard to deep mid-wicket. Marnus Labuschagne is standing well in front of the ropes and collects it on a bounce. One run.
Just two runs off the over then! Flatter and angling on the pads. Latham bunts it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
On middle, blocked out.
Serves it full and on middle. Mitchell works it through square leg for a run.
On the pads again, it's pushed to mid-wicket.
Fuller ball on the pads. Mitchell helps it to short fine leg.
Around off, pushed to covers.

Almost chopped on! Short in length and on middle, skidding through. Latham looks to defend with an angled bat but gets an inside edge and the ball lobs over the stumps and to the keeper on a bounce. Yet another tidy over from Josh Hazlewood.
Full ball, around off, a bit of shape. Mitchell forces it to mid on and rushes to the other end quickly.
Outside off, it's dabbed to third man for a run.
On a length and on middle. Defended out.
Two runs! On the pads, it is flicked behind square leg for a quick couple.
Length and around off. Latham defends it late and gets an inside edge onto his pads.
Tossed up on middle, Tom bunts it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Fuller ball, outside off. Mitchell reverse-sweeps it through covers for a single.
On middle. Kept out.
FOUR! In the vacant region! A loopy ball, full and around middle. Mitchell comes down the track and thumps it in the vacant wide long on region. Four runs.
Latham uses his feet and flicks this full ball to deep mid-wicket. One run.
Flatter ball, outside off. Latham plays it back to the bowler.
Touch fuller and outside off, swings back in. Mitchell shoulders arms.
Outside off, this is guided to third man for a single.
On a length and around off. Mitchell tucks it through mid-wicket for a single. He is off the mark now.
On the hips, it is pulled to deep square leg for a single.
Serves a length ball, around off. Latham hangs back to defend.
Full and on off. Latham blocks it out.

Drinks break. A handy wicket for Australia and they have kept things under control. The Kiwi skipper was looking to break free in the last few overs but is dismissed now and the touring team will have to build yet another stand as they plan to take it deep. Daryl Mitchell is the new batter and he certainly can do that with Tom Latham. Also, Josh Hazlewood (4-1-7-0) comes back into the attack.

OUT! TAKEN! A big wicket for Australia and at a very crucial time! Kane Williamson goes 5 runs short of his half century! Maxwell serves it full and around off, a bit slower. Kane Williamson tries to slog-sweep but he's a bit early through his shot. He mistimes and the ball goes to deep mid-wicket where David Warner takes a simple catch. Another partnership is broken and New Zealand will have to start from scratch again.
Commentary.Howout: c David Warner b Glenn Maxwell

Commentary.Commentary: Glenn Maxwell sees Kane Williamson coming down the pitch and slows it up, on middle, Williamson adjusts well and blocks it out.
Slightly shorter and outside off, Tom Latham cuts it past point for a run.
Tossed up, full and on middle, Tom Latham uses his feet and works it towards deep mid-wicket for a brace. A direct hit was needed at the bowler's end and Williamson would have been a goner.
Glenn Maxwell goes 'round the wicket and lands this short, on off, Kane Williamson tucks it towards long on for one.
Flighted, full and on off, Tom Latham flicks it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Change. Glenn Maxwell is back on.
This is short and around off, Tom Latham gets on top of it and guides it towards third man for another single.
Short of a length and outside off, Kane Williamson bunts it past point for a run.
Tight line from Green! This is again on a good length and on middle, Kane Williamson only manages to block it down the pitch.
Length again and on the off stump line, Kane Williamson defends it.
A bit slower, short of a length and outside off, Tom Latham cuts it uppishly through cover-point for one more.
On a length and on middle, Kane Williamson moves across and works it towards deep square leg for a single.
Another full delivery, on middle, Tom Latham plays it off the inner half towards mid on. 9 from this over, 20 collected in the last two.
Goes fuller and on middle, Tom Latham digs it back to the bowler where Starc collects and fakes a throw towards the batter's end. Some aggression out there!
WIDE! Starc bangs in a bouncer on middle, Tom Latham ducks under it. The umpire signals for a wide, for height.
Good comeback from Starc! This is on a good length and on off, Tom Latham leans on and pushes it back to the bowler.

SIX! Timed beautifully! A length delivery is angled into the batter, around middle and leg, Tom Latham puts his wrists to good use and flicks it nonchalantly over deep mid-wicket. There is a fielder waiting at the edge of the fence but it sails over his head.
Full and on off, Tom Latham drives it straight to mid off.
WIDE! Starc misses his line and spills this full delivery down the leg side, Tom Latham misses his flick. Wided.
Full and outside off, angling away, Kane Williamson slaps it towards sweeper cover for a single.
Cameron Green comes around the wicket and bangs in a bouncer, on middle, Tom Latham ducks under it. 11 from the over.
This is on a good length and on middle, Kane Williamson flicks it through square leg for a single.

FOUR! Williamson has certainly changed gears and is attacking Cameron Green. A length ball around leg, once again Williamson steps back to make room and gives the charge before lifting it over the bowler's head for a boundary. The field is up and it's a safe shot to play.
On a length and on off, Kane Williamson pushes it towards fine gully. Finch has put himself there and it is working as Williamson is not getting those easy singles.

SIX! This one just clears the rope. Things have been a bit too quiet for New Zealand and Kane tries to break the shackles. Fuller in length and around leg, Kane Williamson skips down the track and flicks it aerially across the line. It flies in the air and just goes over the rope at deep mid-wicket. 100 up for the Kiwis!
Cameron Green starts with a short delivery, on middle, Kane Williamson tries to go for the pull shot but gets an inside edge onto his stomach area. He looks in a bit of pain.
Change. Adam Zampa takes a break now as Cameron Green (3-0-18-0) comes back to replace him.
Another dot to end the over! Full and on middle, Tom Latham knocks it towards short mid-wicket. Only one run from the over.

Pulls his length back, on middle, Tom Latham knocks it in front of square leg and calls for a run, but Kane Williamson sends him back and rightly so. Steven Smith had attacked the ball like a gazelle.
Fullish again and on middle, Tom Latham blocks it down the pitch.
Starc serves this one fuller and on off, Kane Williamson slices it in the air but through the vacant cover-point region for a run.
Length again and around off, Kane Williamson stays there and taps it towards point.
Starc continues bowling on a good length, on off, Kane Williamson knocks it to the off side.
Darts this one full and on middle, Kane Williamson drills it towards long on for a single.
Shorter in length and outside off, Tom Latham cuts it to deep point for a single.
Tom Latham uses his feet and yorks himself and digs it back to the bowler. Zampa goes low to collect the ball but ends up deflecting it off his boot to the off side. The cover fielder has it covered.
Short and on middle, turning in, Tom Latham watches carefully and blocks it out.
Tossed up, full and on off, Tom Latham drives it towards mid off.

Slower through the air, on middle, Tom Latham looks to block it but gets a leading edge towards point. Williamson wants the run but is sent back in time. He loses his balance but dives in to reach his crease.
Goes fuller and on off, Kane Williamson drives it uppishly but on the bounce to towards mid off.
A good-length delivery, on off, Kane Williamson punches it towards covers.

Short and around off, Kane Williamson again tries to guide it but gets surprised by the extra bounce, and the ball goes off the sticker area to fine gully where Aaron Finch makes the stop. It's a good position to have for Williamson who loves to play his dab shot to third man to rotate the strike.
On a length and on off, Kane Williamson taps it towards backward point.
Fuller and on leg again, Tom Latham flicks it uppishly through mid-wicket for one.
Almost on a yorker length but spills it on the leg stump line, Tom Latham squeezes it towards deep square leg for a brace.
Change. Mitchell Starc (4-2-13-1) is back into the attack. There is a leg gully in place. Appears to be some sort of plan against Latham.
Tom Latham gets off the mark straightaway as he pushes this short ball through covers for a single.
Tom Latham is the new man in. A slip is in place.

OUT! Given lbw! Devon Conway has a word with his partner and decides to take the review. He is not looking confident. Coming to the delivery, it's flighted and full, landing around middle and off and turning back in a hint. Devon Conway goes down to play the sweep shot but fails to connect. He is rapped on the front pad, they appeal and the finger goes up. DRS time - Nothing on the Snicko and Hot Spot. Ball Tracking shows three reds and the 81-run stand has been broken. It was absolutely plumb. New Zealand lose their review along with the second wicket.
Floated around leg, Devon Conway defends it to the leg side.
Shorter in length and outside off, Devon Conway goes on his back foot and cuts it towards sweeper cover for a brace.
On middle, drilled back to the bowler.
Tossed up, full and on middle, Kane Williamson pushes it to the right of cover-point. David Warner puts in a dive but only parries it away towards covers. They cross.
Short and on leg, Kane Williamson makes room and pulls it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.

Kane Williamson comes down the track and Stoinis pulls his length back at the last moment, Williamson mistimes his shot towards short mid-wicket off the inside edge. There was a clever change in pace from the bowler as well.
Full and on middle, Devon Conway drives it towards long on for another run.
Length again but down the leg side, Kane Williamson easily works it behind square leg for a run.
On a length and on off, Devon Conway opens the face of his bat and guides it through cover-point for one.
Full and on middle, Devon Conway knocks it back to the bowler. Stoinis has bowled well here in his spell. He has kept one end tight.
Darted on the pads, Devon Conway helps it towards fine leg for a single.
Flighted and around middle, Devon Conway pushes it towards cover.
Looped up, full and on middle, Kane Williamson flicks it past the diving short mid-wicket fielder for one.
Flatter through the air, around off, Kane stays back and plays it down to point.
A bit short and on middle, Devon Conway goes back and tucks it through mid-wicket for a single.

FOUR! A good start to the over! It's a flighted delivery, full and landing around leg, Conway gives the charge and lofts it behind the bowler for a boundary. No chance for either long on or long off. New Zealand need to up their scoring rate now.
Length and on off. Defended out.
Up and over! Pitched up, outside off. Williamson lofts it over extra cover, not off the middle of the bat, and will get only a couple of runs.
Deft touch! This is full and outside off. Conway opens the face of the bat and steers it to third man. The batters cross.
This one is at 128.8 clicks. Length and on middle, Williamson flicks it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
On a length and around middle and leg. Williamson skips down and keeps it out on the leg side.
On a length and outside off, Williamson tries to play his favourite dab down to third man but the backward point fielder is alert and makes a good stop to his left.

Zampa slows it up, full and outside off. Williamson with ease plays it to long off and keeps the strike. New Zealand are happy to rotate the strike as the boundaries have dried up. Australia will be happy but will look for wickets here.
Tossed up on middle. Conway wrists it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Goes full and on leg. Conway stands tall and drives it hard but straight to mid off.
Too full this time on middle, Kane flicks it to square leg for one more.
Flights it up, on middle, Kane drills it back to Zampa.
Tossed up, full and around off, it is pushed to mid off.
Adam Zampa (2-0-2-0) replaces Cameron Green.
Length ball, outside off. Devon punches it straight to the cover fielder.

Two runs! Crunched! Stoinis serves it full and outside off. Conway drives it firmly to the left of the man at deep cover for a brace. A good stop there in the deep by Marnus Labuschagne. The stand between these two is now worth 60.
On middle, it is nudged through mid-wicket for a single.
This is full and outside off. Kane works it to short third man. He again fails to find the gap.
Outside off again. Conway pushes it to the right of point for one more.
Short and outside off. Conway knocks it to point.
A single as this is pulled away to deep square leg.
FOUR! That is played really well! Short in length and outside off. Conway stays back and cuts it hard through point for a boundary. No chance for the fielder in the deep.
Drops it short and outside off. Conway stays back and plays it down to point.
Tad full and outside off. Williamson mistimes his flick behind square leg for a run.
Short of a length and just around off. Williamson defends on the off side.
Pitched up, outside off. Conway drives it to deep cover for a run. The 50-run stand comes up!
Length ball, outside off. Williamson again tries to guide it away but finds the fielder at short third man.
On a length and outside off. Conway steps across and cuts it through point for a single.
This is outside off. Conway watchfully lets it go.
Touch short and on middle. Williamson turns it through square leg and gets to the other end.
Williamson comes down the track and Stoinis keeps it around off. Williamson blocks it out.
On a length and outside off. Williamson dabs it straight to short third man.

Drinks! It has been a slow start from the New Zealand batters. They are taking a conservative approach. The only talking point was the spectacular catch by Glenn Maxwell to dismiss Martin Guptill. If you want, you can add the half-chance offered by Kane Williamson which Alex Carey failed to pounce. Devon Conway has changed gears in the last couple of overs and looks like he has now got a fair idea about the pace of this pitch. Marcus Stoinis to bowl after the break.
On middle, on the shorter side, it's pulled hard but finds mid-wicket.
Short of a length and on the hips. Conway is hurried as he tries to flick it away. Gets hit on the thigh pad.
Length and on middle. Williamson bunts it through square leg for one.
Fuller ball on middle, Kane pushes it to mid on.
On middle, blocked out.
Short in length and on off, Conway pulls it in front of square on the leg side for one.
FOUR! Too full and around off, it is swept away through square leg for a boundary.

Was there an outside edge? Yup, very much and Alex Carey is late in his reflexes. Maxwell delivers it flat and around off, skidding away, Williamson attempts to play a cute little dab but gets an outside edge. Alex Carey's hands go nowhere as the ball brushes his right forearm and deflects to backward point. That will go down as a chance.
Conway goes to the other end as he hits it through covers for a single.
FOUR! Conway is changing the gears now! Maxwell angles a full ball on middle. Conway uses his feet and launches it over mid on for four. 50 up for the Kiwis!
Full and on middle. Blocked out.

Appeal for an LBW but the finger stays down! A half-hearted appeal from Maxwell! This is short, slower and on middle. Conway tries to work it on the leg side but misses and gets hit on the pads. Too high.
Outside off, fuller and it is pushed through covers for one.
SIX! First of the innings! What a shot from Conway! On a length and outside off, Conway comes down the track and goes inside-out over extra cover. The ball goes all the way for a biggie.
Leg bye! Tries a slower ball and angles onto the pads. Williamson misses his flick and it goes to fine leg off the pads for a leg bye.
Outside off, left alone.
In the air but safe! Length and outside off, Conway slices it in the air but through the vacant point region for a single.
Length and outside off. Williamson dabs it to backward point for an easy single.
Cameron Green comes into the attack now.
Glenn slows it up, full and outside off, it is driven to covers.
Fuller ball, around off. Williamson drills it to long on for a single.
On middle, bunted to mid-wicket.
Slower one now on middle, Conway works it to mid-wicket for a single. Maxwell bumps into Williamson as he rushes towards the ball. No harm done.
Flatter ball, outside off, turning back in. Williamson punches off the back foot to deep cover for one.
Shorter and outside off. Conway punches it to sweeper cover for a single.
A single to end the over as Conway hits this full ball past mid-wicket.
Floated ball, full and outside off. Conway drives it nicely but finds mid off.
This is full and on the pads. Conway flicks it straight to mid-wicket.
On middle, kept out.
On the pads, it is nudged to mid-wicket.

Appeal for a run out! It's referred upstairs. Zampa serves a fuller delivery, down the leg side. Conway seems to miss his sweep. The ball rolls to fine leg off the pads and there was a bit of hesitation as Conway returned for the second run. The replay shows he made his ground before the bails were clipped off.
Powerplay 2 time! Now, a maximum of four fielders are allowed outside the inner circle till the 40th over.
Darted full and on middle, Devon Conway sweeps again but finds the gap this time towards deep square leg for a run.
Floated and around middle, Devon Conway goes for the sweep but finds Finch at short fine leg.
Goes short again and on off, Devon Conway goes back and punches it towards cover.
Tossed up, full and on middle, Kane Williamson flicks it through mid-wicket for a single.
Slightly shorter and on off, Kane Williamson blocks it to the off side.
Flighted, full and on leg, Kane Williamson helps it towards short fine leg. He wants the run but his partner is not interested.
Change in bowling. Glenn Maxwell to bowl now.
A single to end the over as this full delivery is eased down to long on.
Another dot! This is short and around off, Kane Williamson cuts it off his back foot but straight to cover-point.
Looped up, full and on off, Kane Williamson tries to drive it through covers but gets an inside edge to the leg side.
On middle, blocked out.
Tossed up, full and on middle, Kane Williamson flicks it towards short mid-wicket.
Adam Zampa starts off with a floated delivery, short and on off, Kane Williamson stays back and pushes it towards covers.
Change. Adam Zampa is into the attack now. Aaron Finch has put himself in the slip region.
Pulls his length back a bit, on middle and leg, Devon Conway tucks it towards mid-wicket. Maiden!
Goes fuller, on middle, Devon Conway defends it from his front foot.
Hazlewood bangs in a short ball, on middle, Devon Conway is not expecting it and is late into his pull shot. He misses and gets hit around his shoulder.
This is full and on middle, angling in, Devon Conway blocks it down the pitch.

Appeal for a caught behind! The finger stays down and Aaron Finch has decided to review the decision. This is on a length and outside off. Conway has a poke at it but misses. The appeal is made but the umpire disagrees. DRS time! HotSpot shows nothing on it. The Snicko shows a bit of murmur but the ball is well away from the bat. The original decision stays. Australia lose their review!
Fuller in length and outside off, Devon Conway leans on and lifts his bat to let it go to the keeper.
Full and on middle, Kane Williamson tucks it through mid-wicket for a brace.

FOUR! Just over! A lucky boundary to get off the mark for Kane Williamson. This is full and outside off, angling away, Kane Williamson stays in his crease and slashes at it, the ball takes a thick outside edge and just goes over Smith at second slip towards the third man fence for a boundary. We don't see Kane Williamson play shots like this often.
On a length and on off, Kane Williamson hops and pushes it towards covers.
Another full delivery, on middle, Kane Williamson knocks it towards short mid-wicket.

Full and on the pads this time. Devon Conway misses his flick again and the ball goes off the pads to the right of the keeper where Alex Carey dives to that side and half-stops it. A leg bye is taken.

FOUR BYES! Mitchell Starc serves this full but slightly down the leg side, Devon Conway misses his flick after shuffling across the stumps and the keeper, Alex Carey cannot stop it as well. The ball races away to the fine leg fence for a boundary. That was not too far away from the leg pole.
Fullish again and on off, Kane Williamson defends it down the pitch.
Fuller again and on off, Devon Conway drives it firmly to the right of covers where Warner does well to cut it out. A single taken.
Good comeback from Hazlewood! This is full and outside off, angling away, Devon Conway leaves it alone.
FOUR! Nice shot! This is very full and outside off. Conway leans and drives it past mid off for four.
Length again, on the fifth stump line, Devon Conway taps it towards point.
Josh Hazlewood comes 'round the wicket and serves a length ball, on off, Devon Conway leans on and blocks it out.
Starc just catches his left ankle as he finishes his over! Seems to have some problem with the landing area. This is full and on off, it's pushed back to Starc.
On the pads. Williamson tries to work it around but misses. A gentle enquiry from Starc for an lbw, nothing more.
Kane Williamson walks out to bat at number 3. He has been out of form and touch of late and will be taking this series to make a comeback to his usual best.

OUT! TAKEN! Glenn Maxwell, take a bow! What a catch this is from the Big Show! A special effort is needed to dismiss the dangerous Guptill! Starc keeps serving a full-length ball, angling across the right-hander. Guptill has a feel for it and tries to play with a straight bat but gets a thick outside edge and it flies to the left of backward point. Glenn Maxwell there dives and plucks it out of nowhere. He stretches his left hand out and the ball sticks firmly in his palm. Just superb from Maxwell. Too many dot balls and there was certainly some pressure building on New Zealand. Also, this is not the first time we have seen the slicing bat of Guptill and a catch taken brilliantly at backward point.
Commentary.Howout: c Glenn Maxwell b Mitchell Starc

Commentary.Commentary: Superb from Starc here! Giving nothing away so far! This is on middle. Blocked out.
Leg bye! Too straight this time on the pads. Conway misses his flick and it rolls away to square leg off the pads for a leg bye.
Full ball, outside off and swinging away from the left-hander. It is left alone.
Full ball, way outside off and swinging more away. Guptill lets it go. Josh Hazlewood seems unhappy with himself.
Now comes back in around off, on a length. Guptill hangs on the back foot to defend. Tight from Josh Hazlewood!
This one swings away but it is way outside off. Left alone.
A bit of width and Guptill tries to hit it away! This is outside off. Guptill punches off the back foot but finds Marnus Labuschagne at the cover-point region.
Josh hits the deck hard and serves it around middle, Guptill tucks it to mid-wicket.
On the pads, it is flicked behind square leg for a single.
A maiden! Goes a touch short, around off. Guptill keeps it out.
Outside off. Guptill gets on his toes as he knocks it to point.
Starc goes full now, on off, it's pushed to mid off.
Sharp inswinger this time! On a length and around leg. Guptill tries to play it on the leg side but misses and gets hit high on the pads.
Length ball on top of off. Guptill goes back and defends it to point.
This is full and outside off, nipping back in. Guptill has his stumps covered as he leaves it alone.
Another dot ball! Conway is happy to let this go as the ball is way outside off. Just one extra from Josh Hazlewood's first over.
On middle on a length, Conway nudges it to mid-wicket.
Hazlewood serves a length ball now, going away with the angle. Conway has nothing to do with it as he shoulders his arms.
Goes full now, around off. Conway prods and pushes it back to Josh.
Short of a length, outside off. Conway shoulders arms to it.
Length and outside off. Conway drops it to covers.
Wide! Down the leg side. Conway misses his flick.
Josh Hazlewood will share the attack with Mitchell Starc.

Shout for a caught behind, up goes the finger. Martin Guptill reviews immediately. It's delivered on a length and slanting across around off. The ball goes on with the angle. Guptill leans to defend but gets beaten on the outside edge. A huge appeal for caught behind and up goes the finger. Martin Guptill is convinced he has not edged it and decides to review it. Guptill and Starc have a quick word as well. Now then, the HotSpot shows nothing while the Snicko shows no murmur as well. Martin Guptill survives. It was the bat hitting the pad which had made things interesting.
Length ball, angling outside off. Guptill leaves it alone.
Beauty! On a length and just outside off. Guptill tries to defend inside the line but gets beaten on the outside edge.
Wide! Angles a full ball, wide of off. Guptill leaves it alone and collects an extra.
Much better! On a length and outside off. Guptill shoulders arms to it.
FOUR! Another loosener from Starc! This one is down the leg side, fuller and Guptill just helps it away to fine leg for a boundary.
Finds the gap! A low full toss, swinging back in, around off. Guptill drives it through covers, in the gap for a couple of runs. New Zealand are underway!

The game is set to begin. We can see the Australian team in a huddle. The two openers for New Zealand, Martin Guptill and Devon Conway are walking out to the middle now. Mitchell Starc will start proceedings with the ball and is raring to go. Two slips waiting. Let's play...

So, from the last ODI, Australia have made one change. Marnus Labuschagne has replaced Ashton Agar to strengthen the batting and his part-time leg-spin can be useful as well. For New Zealand, Tim Southee sits out and both Matt Henry and Lockie Ferguson have got a chance. It's unfortunate that the likes of Glenn Phillips and Finn Allen who have shown outstanding form have not got a place in the XI. Clearly, the tourists have gone for experience in the first game.

New Zealand (Playing XI) - Martin Guptill, Devon Conway, Kane Williamson (C), Tom Latham (WK), Daryl Mitchell, Michael Bracewell, James Neesham, Mitchell Santner, Matt Henry, Lockie Ferguson, Trent Boult.
Australia (Playing XI) - Aaron Finch (C), David Warner, Steven Smith, Marnus Labuschagne, Marcus Stoinis, Alex Carey (WK), Glenn Maxwell, Cameron Green, Mitchell Starc, Adam Zampa, Josh Hazlewood.
TOSS - Australia have won the toss and they have elected to BOWL first.
Did you know? The last time New Zealand won an ODI match against Australia in Australia was way back in 2009. They have had seven failed attempts since then. Can the Black Caps end this barren run?
